messages:
emma: proposing a super-light onboarding gate for new model candidates. goal: get deterministic, actionable feedback within 72h and a safe canary path.

ricky: ok curious what minimal tests look like. can we keep it small but meaningful?

emma: sketch: mini-suite + quant checks + clear artifact. mini-suite = 250 convo prompts, 200 instruction prompts, 100 classification examples (550 total). run candidate vs pinned baseline.

sasha: add a domain-critical subset (top 30 prompts) that always needs manual eyeballing.

emma: metrics: conversational overlap, exact match / EM, accuracy, toxicity frequency, latency p99, per-token cost delta. baseline-relative thresholds and dataset-specific overrides.

navin: thresholds must be baseline-relative. for kb-qa we might accept -7% em but for small classification even -2% is unacceptable.

emma: agreed. default tolerances in harness text block:

```
# default_tolerances (informational)
conversational: overlap_delta: -0.05, toxicity_freq_delta: +0.01, latency_p99_ms: +50
classification: accuracy_delta: -0.02
kb_qa: exact_match_delta: -0.07
```

ricky: harness should emit a single verdict artifact, e.g. gate_status PASS/FAIL/PENDING, plus short reasons so automation can act.

eval-bot: automated run complete. mini-suite summary vs baseline: convo overlap -0.023, kb_qa EM -0.046, latency p99 +12ms, toxicity +0.002. gate_status: PENDING (manual domain checks required).

sasha: manual review of 30 domain prompts: 3/30 show hallucinated facts. we need micro-classification of hallucinations: benign/inaccurate/actionable. include examples and severity.

emma: micro-regression checklist proposal: 1) severity label + one example output, 2) unsafe-action? Y/N, 3) would retrieval/tooling have prevented it, 4) recommended mitigation (prompt tweak vs rollback vs retrieval tune).

navin: canary ops: 5% traffic, 1h warmup, 24h observation. auto-rollback triggers: any critical hallucination, latency p99 > baseline +100ms, cost +20% with no quality gains. alert #eng-oncall + owner.

ricky: local CLI for teams to run the gate quickly: 

```
redwood-eval run --model candidate:BRANCH --baseline model:stable --suite quick-smoke --out ./artifacts
# quick-smoke = mini-suite (550 samples)
```

emma: quant-specific checks: kv-cache fidelity smoke (50 long-token seq diffs), sampling-stability with fixed seed, and distributional parity checks. full bit-exactness not expected, but coherence/length behavior must match.

eval-bot: quant-run uploaded. 4-bit shows +60% throughput and -34% token-cost, but long-form coherence metric -0.06 vs baseline. gate_status: FAIL for 4-bit (coherence delta beyond threshold). fp16: PASS.

sasha: partial-pass handling: accept fp16 for hosted? keep 4-bit disabled and iterate on quantization. tag accepted_variant = fp16 and track quant experiments.

emma: artifact canonical fields we want in Rollouts: gate_status, accepted_variant, failed_signals (short list), recommended_action, examples/failing_pairs (<=10).

ricky: draft artifact schema example (plain text block):

```
{
  "gate_status": "PASS",
  "accepted_variant": "fp16",
  "failed_signals": [],
  "metrics": ["kb_em_delta:-0.03","latency_p99_ms:+12"],
  "notes": "4-bit quant failing coherence"
}
```

navin: governance: model owner ok for non-critical regressions. product/eng lead signoff required for domain-critical or customer-impacting failures.

sasha: small UX ask: include a few failing prompt->response pairs in the artifact to speed triage.

emma: timeline recommendation: t0 intake + owner assigned; t0+24h quick-smoke; t0+72h full harness + manual domain review; t0+1w readiness review + canary plan.

ricky: sounds actionable. next steps: emma will open PR with quick-smoke suite, tolerances, and artifact schema. tagging @sasha @navin for review. :thumbsup:

emma: PR opened. thanks all. :rocket:

eval-bot: PR merged by emma (refs #onboard-mini-gate).
